t: I'd planned to return these library books at the counter today, but it was closed for a system upgrade, so I just dropped them in the after-hours box outside instead.
so I just dropped them in the after-hours box outside instead.
意味は、「カウンターが閉まっていたので、外の時間外ポストに入れた」。instead が「予定(カウンター返却)ではなく外のポスト」への切り替えの合図。closed の一語で予定が崩れる。
The app promised it would clear up by noon, so I left my umbrella at home. Big mistake — it came down in buckets all afternoon.
Big mistake — it came down in buckets all afternoon.
意味は、「予報を信じて傘を置いてきたが、午後は土砂降りだった」。come down in buckets =「バケツをひっくり返したように降る」。Big mistake が予報を信じた失敗を示す。
My brother said that new mystery film was dull, but I couldn't disagree more. I was on the edge of my seat the whole way through.
I couldn't disagree more. I was on the edge of my seat.
意味は、「全く同感できない。最後までハラハラ通しだった」。couldn't disagree more =「これ以上ないほど反対」。on the edge of my seat =「手に汗握る」。兄の評価とは正反対。
I usually cycle to school, but my back tire went flat this morning, and the repair shop doesn't open till ten, so I ended up sprinting to catch the bus.
so I ended up sprinting to catch the bus.
意味は、「結局、走ってバスに間に合わせた」。パンク→店は10時開店→バスへ、の連鎖。ended up ...ing =「結局〜することになった」。usually cycle に引きずられない。
A woman is carrying a stack of boxes so tall that she can't see over the top, and a small dog is trotting along right behind her heels.
carrying a stack of boxes so tall that she can't see over the top, a small dog right behind.
意味は、「前が見えないほど箱を高く積んで運ぶ女性と、後ろをついていく小犬」。so tall that she can't see over =「上を見越せないほど高い」、behind her heels =「すぐ後ろ」。犬の位置(後ろ)がカギ。
There are four cups on the tray, but only the two on the left have saucers underneath them.
four cups, but only the two on the left have saucers.
意味は、「カップは4つ、受け皿は左の2つだけ」。only ... on the left =「左のものだけ」。数(4)と、受け皿のある位置(左2つ)の両方を保持する。
The clock on the wall says ten past three, while the calendar hanging next to it is still turned to last month.
ten past three, the calendar still turned to last month.
意味は、「時計は3時10分、カレンダーは先月のまま」。ten past three =「3時10分」。still turned to last month =「先月のまま」。時刻表現と「めくり忘れ」の2点。
Let's meet at six in front of the station.
The six o'clock train is often delayed. Could we make it a quarter to six, just to be safe?
Sure, five forty-five it is.
Could we make it a quarter to six? — five forty-five it is.
意味は、「6時への提案を「6時15分前(=5:45)」に修正して合意」。a quarter to six =「6時の15分前」=5:45。最初の6時が修正される。to は「前」。
I booked window seats for all three of us.
Actually, my cousin gets carsick, so could two of us switch to the aisle?
No problem, I'll change two to aisle seats.
I'll change two to aisle seats.
意味は、「3席の窓側予約のうち2席を通路側に変更」。最初は窓側3席→2席を通路側へ。変更後の内訳(通路2+窓1)を計算する。
I'll have the lunch set with rice.
The set comes with either rice or bread, not both.
Ah, bread then. And could I swap the side salad for soup?
bread then. And could I swap the side salad for soup?
意味は、「パンを選び、サイドのサラダをスープに変更」。rice→bread に訂正、salad→soup に変更。2か所の言い直しを最後まで追う。
Shall we go hiking on Saturday?
The forecast says rain on Saturday but clear skies on Sunday.
Then let's swap — hike on Sunday, and do the indoor museum on Saturday instead.
hike on Sunday, and do the indoor museum on Saturday instead.
意味は、「日曜にハイキング、土曜は屋内の美術館に変更」。swap(入れ替え)で土日が逆転。「土曜=美術館」を取り出す。instead が入れ替えの合図。
Are you coming to Ken's farewell party on Friday night?
I've got my driving test first thing Saturday morning.
I've got my driving test first thing Saturday morning.
意味は、「土曜の朝いちばんに運転免許の試験がある」。直接「行かない」とは言わず、翌朝の試験を理由に暗に難色を示す。含意を読む問題。
How was that new café everyone's talking about?
Well... the cakes were absolutely Instagram-perfect.
the cakes were absolutely Instagram-perfect.
意味は、「ケーキは見栄えだけは完璧だった」。「見た目(Instagram向け)」だけをほめるのは、味への遠回しな不満。Well... のためらいもヒント。
Did the whole group finish the report?
Let's just say I did my part.
Let's just say I did my part.
意味は、「まあ、自分の担当分はやった、とだけ言っておくよ」。「自分の分は(少なくとも)やった」という言い回しは、他のメンバーが未完であることをほのめかす。
We need a drummer for our band. Want to join?
I haven't so much as touched a drum kit since I was thirteen.
I haven't so much as touched a drum kit since I was thirteen.
意味は、「13歳以来ドラムに触れてすらいない」。haven't so much as touched =「触れてすらいない」。ブランクの長さを挙げて、やんわり尻込みしている。
You look exhausted. Another all-nighter?
The deadline got moved up a week, so I really didn't have a choice.
The deadline got moved up a week, so I really didn't have a choice.
意味は、「締め切りが1週間早まって、どうしようもなかった」。moved up =「(予定が)早まる」。didn't have a choice =「選択の余地がなかった」。早まった、を聞き取る。
Should we take the highway to get there faster?
At this hour? We'd be stuck bumper to bumper for an hour.
At this hour? We'd be stuck bumper to bumper for an hour.
意味は、「今の時間帯? 1時間は渋滞にはまるよ」。bumper to bumper =「数珠つなぎの渋滞」。反語(At this hour?)で高速を避けるべきと示す。

Welcome to the City Science Museum. The dinosaur hall is on the first floor. The space exhibit, which used to be on the second floor, has moved up to the fourth floor to make room for our new robotics zone, which is now on the second floor. The planetarium is right at the top, on the fifth floor. Note that the gift shop by the first-floor exit closes thirty minutes before the museum does.
The dinosaur hall is on the first floor.
意味は、「恐竜ホールは1階」。冒頭で提示。最初の情報を取りこぼさない。
our new robotics zone, which is now on the second floor.
意味は、「新設のロボティクスゾーンは2階」。宇宙展示が抜けた2階に新設。「宇宙の跡地=2階」を取り違えない。
The space exhibit used to be on the second floor, has moved up to the fourth floor.
意味は、「宇宙展示は2階から4階へ移動」。used to be(以前)+moved up(移動)の変更ワナ。今の場所は4階。
The planetarium is right at the top, on the fifth floor.
意味は、「プラネタリウムは最上階の5階」。right at the top =「いちばん上」= 5階。最後の gift shop の話は表に無関係。

Here is today's craft workshop schedule. We start at ten with paper folding in Room A. At eleven, we have pottery — but please note it is now in Room C, not Room B as printed on your sheet. Lunch is at noon. The afternoon dyeing session was going to begin at one, but we'll start fifteen minutes later, at one fifteen, because the dye needs extra time to prepare.
paper folding in Room A.
意味は、「折り紙はA室」。最初の部屋。Room A を確実に。
pottery — now in Room C, not Room B as printed.
意味は、「陶芸は(印刷はB室だが)C室に変更」。not B as printed =「印刷のBではなく」。変更後のC室が正解。
The afternoon dyeing session.
意味は、「午後は染色のセッション」。dyeing =「染色」。午前の折り紙・陶芸と区別。
we'll start fifteen minutes later, at one fifteen.
意味は、「準備の都合で1時15分開始に変更」。was going to begin at one(予定1時)→ fifteen minutes later(15分後)=1:15。
Number one. The café job is weekdays only, pays nine hundred fifty yen an hour, and no experience is needed.
Number two. The bookstore job includes weekends and pays one thousand fifty yen, but you must have worked in retail before.
Number three. The delivery job is on weekends, pays one thousand two hundred yen, and beginners are fine — but you have to bring your own bike.
Number four. The tutoring job is on weekends, pays eleven hundred yen, beginners are welcome, and nothing special is required.
The tutoring job: weekends, eleven hundred yen, beginners welcome, nothing special required.
意味は、「家庭教師=週末・1100円・未経験可・特別な持ち物なしで全条件を満たす」。1=平日+950円(✕)、2=経験必須(✕)、3=自前の自転車が必要(✕)、4=全条件を満たす。

In recent years, some companies have experimented with a four-day work week, where employees work four days but receive the same pay as for five. In one large trial in the UK, more than ninety percent of the companies chose to keep the shorter week after the test ended. Why? First, many workers reported less stress and better sleep. Second, people cut down on long, pointless meetings, so the same amount of work still got done. Third, fewer sick days were taken. However, the results are not the same across all jobs. In factories or hospitals, where someone must always be on duty, simply removing a day is hard. Some managers also worry that squeezing five days of work into four just makes each day more stressful. Researchers conclude that the four-day week is promising, but it should be tested carefully industry by industry, rather than forced on everyone at once.
the four-day week is promising, but it should be tested carefully industry by industry.
意味は、「週4日制は有望だが、業種ごとに慎重に試すべきだ」。promising but ...(有望だが〜)の後ろに結論。「一律導入」ではなく「業種ごとに慎重に」が主旨。
more than ninety percent of the companies chose to keep the shorter week.
意味は、「90%を超える企業が短い週を続けると決めた」。more than ninety percent =「90%超」。ninety(90)と nineteen(19)の音の違いにも注意。
less stress, better sleep; cut down on meetings; fewer sick days.
意味は、「理由はストレス減・睡眠改善・会議削減・病欠減。給料削減は挙げていない」。給料は「5日分と同じ」と述べており、減らす話はしていない。First/Second/Third の3点に無い。
people cut down on long, pointless meetings, so the same work still got done.
意味は、「長く無駄な会議を減らし、同じ量の仕事を終えられた」。pointless meetings =「無駄な会議」。「必ず」「2倍」などの言い過ぎ選択肢は誤り。
squeezing five days of work into four just makes each day more stressful.
意味は、「5日分を4日に詰め込むと、かえって各日が大変になる」。squeeze ... into =「〜に詰め込む」。時短が逆にストレスを生むという懸念。
In factories or hospitals, where someone must always be on duty.
意味は、「常に誰かが勤務している必要がある工場や病院」。must always be on duty =「常時勤務が必要」。一日減らしにくい職場の例。
tested carefully industry by industry, rather than forced on everyone at once.
意味は、「全員に一度に強制せず、業種ごとに慎重に試すべきだ」。rather than forced on everyone(一律強制ではなく)。主旨(問27)と重なる結論を細部まで問う。
Our school is thinking of switching completely to digital textbooks next year.
I can see the appeal — lighter bags, and you can search a word in seconds. But honestly, I remember things far better when I write notes in the margins of a paper book.
You can annotate on tablets too, though.
True, but studies suggest we scroll past screen text more quickly and retain less. I'd keep paper for the subjects that need slow, deep reading.
So maybe a mix — digital for reference books, and paper for the ones we study closely.
I remember things far better when I write notes in the margins; keep paper for subjects that need deep reading.
意味は、「余白に書き込むと記憶に残りやすく、じっくり読む科目に向くから」。write notes in the margins =「余白に書き込む」、retain less =「記憶に残りにくい」。深い読解の科目は紙、が主張。
a mix — digital for reference books, and paper for the ones we study closely.
意味は、「参考書はデジタル、深く学ぶ教科は紙、という使い分け」。a mix(折衷案)。用途で分ける第3の道。completely digital という当初案が修正される。
Four students are discussing whether their festival food stalls should accept only electronic payment.
I'm all for it. Lines move faster, and we won't lose track of cash.
I see the point, but some first-year students' families may not use e-money at all. We'd lose those sales.
And here's a bigger risk — if the school Wi-Fi goes down during the festival, nobody can pay at all.
Then what if we accept both, but put up clear signs saying e-money is faster? Most people would choose it, and cash stays as a backup.
if the school Wi-Fi goes down during the festival, nobody can pay at all.
意味は、「文化祭中にWi-Fiが止まると、誰も支払えなくなる」。a bigger risk(より大きなリスク)の後ろが答え。通信障害で決済不能、という懸念。
accept both, but put up clear signs saying e-money is faster; cash stays as a backup.
意味は、「両方受け付け、電子が速いと案内しつつ現金も残す」。what if ...?(〜はどう?)が妥協案の合図。electronic only の当初案を「両方＋案内」で解決。
I meant to sort the recycling last night, but I was so worn out that I just left it by the door — I'll deal with it after work today.
I'll deal with it after work today.
意味は、「疲れて放置したので、今日仕事の後に片づける」。meant to(〜するつもりだった)+ but で予定倒れ。deal with it after work =「仕事後に対処」。
I thought I'd given myself plenty of time by leaving early, but a signal failure stopped every train, and I still turned up late.
a signal failure stopped every train, and I still turned up late.
意味は、「早めに出たのに信号故障で電車が止まり、遅刻した」。still turned up late =「それでも遅れて着いた」。早発ちが無駄になった逆接を聞く。
Everyone kept raving about that restaurant, but honestly, for those prices, I expected a whole lot more.
for those prices, I expected a whole lot more.
意味は、「あの値段のわりに、もっと良くて当然だと思った」。for those prices, I expected more =「値段のわりに期待外れ」。raving(絶賛)に流されない。
I was all set to buy the paperback, but the e-book was half the price and I could start reading it on the spot, so I went with that.
the e-book was half the price ... so I went with that.
意味は、「半額ですぐ読める電子書籍にした」。went with that = that(=the e-book)を選んだ。all set to buy the paperback は結局取りやめ。
A man is watering the balcony plants while holding an umbrella over himself, even though the sky is perfectly clear.
watering the plants while holding an umbrella, even though the sky is clear.
意味は、「快晴なのに傘をさして水やりしている」。even though the sky is clear =「晴れているのに」。傘＋晴れの不一致がポイント。
Of the three paintings on the wall, only the one in the middle is hanging crooked.
only the one in the middle is hanging crooked.
意味は、「3枚のうち真ん中の1枚だけが傾いている」。only the middle one =「真ん中だけ」、crooked =「傾いた」。枚数と位置の両方。
A cat is curled up asleep inside an open suitcase, surrounded by neatly folded clothes.
a cat asleep inside an open suitcase, surrounded by neatly folded clothes.
意味は、「開いたスーツケースの中で眠る猫、周りにたたんだ服」。inside an open suitcase =「開いたケースの中」、neatly folded =「きちんとたたんだ」。
These sneakers are size 26. Do you have them one size up?
Let me see... We only have 27 in black, not in white.
Black's fine. I'll take the 27.
We only have 27 in black. — Black's fine. I'll take the 27.
意味は、「白の27はなく、黒の27なら在庫あり→黒の27を購入」。希望(白・ワンサイズ上)が在庫の都合で「黒の27」に。色とサイズの両方を最後まで。
Let's book the seven o'clock show.
It's sold out. There's a nine o'clock, or a four o'clock matinee.
Nine is too late on a weeknight. The matinee, then.
The matinee, then. (= the four o'clock matinee)
意味は、「7時は完売、9時は遅い→午後4時の昼公演に」。matinee =「昼公演」。7時完売→9時は遅い→4時、と消去法で決まる。
The recipe calls for two eggs and a cup of milk.
We're out of milk. Could we use yogurt instead?
Sure, but if we do, use just one egg.
use yogurt instead ... use just one egg.
意味は、「牛乳の代わりにヨーグルト、卵は1個に」。牛乳→ヨーグルト、卵は2個→1個。2か所の変更を両方反映する。
Shall we drive to the lake this weekend?
Gas is so pricey now. The train goes right to the lake and costs less.
Good point — let's take the train.
The train goes right to the lake ... let's take the train.
意味は、「ガソリン高騰のため、車をやめて電車で行く」。当初は車→ガソリン代を理由に電車へ変更。Good point が同意の合図。
Did you enjoy the three-hour museum tour?
Let's just say three hours was... generous.
three hours was... generous.
意味は、「3時間は…たっぷり(=長すぎ)だった」。generous を「たっぷり」と皮肉で使い、長すぎたと遠回しに示す。間(...)もヒント。
Are you going to apply for the exchange program?
My parents aren't exactly thrilled about the idea.
My parents aren't exactly thrilled about the idea.
意味は、「両親はその案にあまり乗り気ではない」。not exactly thrilled =「あまり乗り気でない」の遠回し表現。反対寄りだと読む。
How's your new roommate?
Well, I've learned to sleep with earplugs.
I've learned to sleep with earplugs.
意味は、「耳栓をして眠るようになった(=うるさい)」。耳栓が必要になった、という事実からルームメイトの騒がしさを推測させる。
Can you help me move on Sunday?
I'd love to, but my back's been killing me all week.
I'd love to, but my back's been killing me all week.
意味は、「手伝いたいが、腰がずっと痛くて無理」。I'd love to, but ... =「したいけれど(できない)」の丁寧な断り。理由は腰痛。
You finished the whole novel already?
I honestly couldn't put it down.
I couldn't put it down.
意味は、「面白くて本を置けなかった(=一気読み)」。couldn't put it down =「(面白くて)手放せなかった」= 夢中で読んだ、の定番表現。
Is the new phone worth buying now?
Unless you really need the better camera, I'd hold off.
Unless you really need the better camera, I'd hold off.
意味は、「カメラが本当に必要でなければ、見送るべき」。Unless ...(〜でない限り)+ hold off(見送る)。条件つきで購入を勧めない。

Welcome to Sakura University's open campus. The admissions office is on the first floor of the main building. The library, which was in Building B, has been relocated to Building C this year. The student cafeteria is on the second floor of Building A. Free campus tours leave from the main gate every thirty minutes.
The admissions office is on the first floor of the main building.
意味は、「入学課は本館1階」。冒頭の情報。main building の first floor。
The library, which was in Building B, has been relocated to Building C.
意味は、「図書館はB棟からC棟へ移転」。was in B → relocated to C。今の場所はC棟。移転ワナ。
The student cafeteria is on the second floor of Building A.
意味は、「学生食堂はA棟2階」。Building A の second floor。棟と階の両方。
Free campus tours leave from the main gate every thirty minutes.
意味は、「ツアーは正門から30分ごとに出発」。leave from the main gate。頻度(30分ごと)も添える。

Here is today's stage schedule. The dance club performs at ten. The brass band was scheduled for eleven, but they've swapped slots with the drama club, so drama is now at eleven and the band moves to one. Lunch is at noon. Don't miss the closing chorus at three.
The dance club performs at ten.
意味は、「10時はダンス部」。冒頭。dance club at ten。
they've swapped slots ... drama is now at eleven.
意味は、「入れ替えで11時は演劇部に」。swapped slots =「枠を交換」。11時は吹奏楽→演劇に変更。
the band moves to one.
意味は、「吹奏楽部は13時に移動」。moves to one =「1時に移る」。入れ替えの相手側。
Don't miss the closing chorus at three.
意味は、「15時は締めの合唱」。closing chorus at three =「3時に締めの合唱」。
Number one. The pottery course meets on weekday afternoons, in person only, and there's a materials fee.
Number two. The coding course is on weekday mornings, can be taken online, and has no extra materials fee — the textbook is a free PDF.
Number three. The cooking course is on weekend mornings, in person, and you pay for ingredients.
Number four. The drawing course is on weekday mornings and available online, but you must buy your own sketchbook.
The coding course: weekday mornings, online, no extra materials fee, free PDF textbook.
意味は、「プログラミング=平日午前・オンライン可・教材費なし(無料PDF)で全条件を満たす」。1=平日午後・対面のみ(✕)、3=週末(✕)、4=スケッチブック購入が必要(✕)、2=全条件を満たす。

Food waste is a huge global problem. About one third of all the food produced in the world is never eaten. In our homes, the biggest single cause is buying more than we can actually use, so food spoils before we cook it. Restaurants and shops also throw away food that simply looks slightly imperfect, even though it is perfectly safe to eat. And wasting food wastes far more than money: producing that food used water, land, and energy, and when food rots in landfills it releases greenhouse gases. So what can we do? First, plan your meals and shop with a list. Second, remember that 'best before' dates are about quality, not safety, so many foods are still fine afterward. Third, support shops that sell imperfect vegetables cheaply. Experts stress that small daily choices, multiplied across millions of households, add up to an enormous difference.
small daily choices, multiplied across millions of households, add up to an enormous difference.
意味は、「食品ロスは深刻だが、日々の小さな選択の積み重ねで大きく減らせる」。問題提起→原因→対策→『小さな選択が大差を生む』という結論。主旨は最後の一文。
About one third of all the food produced is never eaten.
意味は、「生産された食品の約3分の1が食べられていない」。one third =「3分の1」。冒頭の代表的な数字。
the biggest single cause is buying more than we can actually use.
意味は、「使い切れる量以上に買ってしまうこと」。biggest single cause =「最大の単一の原因」。買いすぎで傷ませる。
'best before' dates are about quality, not safety, so many foods are still fine afterward.
意味は、「賞味期限は安全ではなく品質の目安で、過ぎても食べられることが多い」。about quality, not safety =「安全ではなく品質」。過剰廃棄を防ぐ知識。
producing that food used water, land, and energy, and rotting food releases greenhouse gases.

Sleep also clears away waste products that build up in the brain while we are awake. So what does this mean for students? First, review your material and then sleep, rather than pulling an all-nighter. Second, keep a regular sleep schedule, because the brain works best on a routine. Third, avoid bright screens just before bed, since their light makes it harder to fall asleep. Researchers conclude that sleep is not lost study time — it is when much of real learning actually happens.

意味は、「睡眠は勉強時間の損失ではなく、多くの学習が実際に起こる時間だ」。問題提起(徹夜は逆効果)→仕組み→助言→結論。最後の一文が主旨。

students who slept a full night after studying remembered far more than those who stayed awake.

When we think about which animals matter most to our food, we might picture cows or chickens, but one of the most important is far smaller: the bee. Without them, foods like apples, almonds, and many vegetables would become scarce and expensive. Yet in many countries the number of bees is falling. Scientists point to several causes: the loss of wild flowers as land is developed, certain pesticides that harm bees, and diseases that spread through hives. The good news is that ordinary people can help. Planting flowers that bloom in different seasons, avoiding harmful chemicals in the garden, and supporting local beekeepers all make a difference. 意味は、「小さなミツバチの保護は、私たち自身の食料供給を守ることだ」。重要性→減少と原因→対策→結論。最後の一文が主旨。

Plastic has made modern life very convenient, but it has created a serious problem. Most plastic is used only once and then thrown away, and a great deal of it ends up in the ocean. Scientists estimate that millions of tons of plastic reach the sea every single year. There, it slowly breaks into tiny pieces called microplastics, which sea animals mistake for food. These pieces can move up the food chain and even end up in the fish that we eat. So what can be done? First, individuals can carry reusable bags and bottles instead of single-use ones. Second, companies can design products with far less packaging. Third, governments can charge for plastic bags or ban certain single-use items. However, experts warn that recycling alone is not enough, because only a small share of plastic is actually recycled. The real key, they say, is to produce and use less plastic in the first place.

意味は、「深刻な問題で、リサイクルだけでなく、そもそも作り・使う量を減らすことが鍵」。問題→仕組み→対策→『リサイクルだけでは不十分、減らすことが鍵』が結論。
it breaks into tiny pieces called microplastics.

Music is found in every human culture, and scientists are learning why it affects us so powerfully. When we listen to music we enjoy, the brain releases chemicals linked to pleasure — the same ones connected to food and other rewards. Music can also change how we feel: a fast, bright song can lift our mood, while a slow one can calm us down. Research points to other benefits too. Learning to play an instrument as a child is linked to stronger memory and language skills, because it trains many parts of the brain at the same time. In hospitals, gentle music has been used to lower patients' stress and even reduce the amount of pain medicine they need. Still, scientists are careful to say that music is not magic — it works best alongside proper treatment, not instead of it. What is clear is that this ancient human activity is far more than mere entertainment.
this ancient human activity is far more than mere entertainment.
意味は、「音楽は単なる娯楽をはるかに超え、脳・気分・健康に多くの影響を与える」。利点を列挙し『娯楽以上』で締める。far more than mere entertainment が主旨。
the brain releases chemicals linked to pleasure — the same ones connected to food and other rewards.
意味は、「快楽に関わる化学物質(食べ物などの報酬と同じもの)」。chemicals linked to pleasure。食事などの報酬と同じ系統。
music is not magic ... works best alongside proper treatment, not instead of it.

Learning to play an instrument as a child is linked to stronger memory and language skills.

Speaking more than one language is common around the world, and researchers have found that it brings some surprising benefits. The most obvious one is communication: bilingual people can talk with more people and enter two cultures. But the advantages go deeper. Constantly switching between languages seems to train the brain, and studies suggest that bilingual people are often better at focusing and ignoring distractions. Some research even indicates that lifelong bilingualism may delay the onset of memory problems in old age by several years. Learning a second language also helps people understand their first language better, and it opens doors to jobs and travel. Of course, becoming bilingual takes years of effort, and the skills fade without practice. But experts stress that it is never too late to start, and that even a limited ability in another language brings real benefits.
the advantages go deeper ... even a limited ability brings real benefits.
意味は、「二言語話者には意思疎通を超えた、脳や人生への多くの深い利点がある」。『最も明白な利点は意思疎通、しかし利点はもっと深い』という構成。深い利点が主旨。

意味は、「より多くの人と話せ、2つの文化に入っていけること」。The most obvious =「最も明白な」。意思疎通と2文化へのアクセス。
focusing and ignoring distractions; delay memory problems; understand first language better.

I carried my umbrella around all day expecting rain, but it stayed sunny the entire time.
it stayed sunny the entire time.
意味は、「雨に備えたが、一日中晴れていた」。expecting rain, but stayed sunny。予想と実際が逆。傘は使わずじまい。
The cake looked really plain, but one bite and I understood why there was such a long line.
one bite and I understood why there was such a long line.
意味は、「見た目は地味だが、一口で行列の理由が分かった(=美味)」。looked plain, but ... long line(行列の訳が分かった)。見た目以上の味。
I was going to walk, but I was running late, so I grabbed a taxi in the end.
I was running late, so I grabbed a taxi in the end.
意味は、「遅れそうだったので、歩くのをやめてタクシーにした」。going to walk but running late → taxi。当初の徒歩から変更。
A cat is chasing its own tail in the middle of a pile of scattered toys.
chasing its own tail in the middle of scattered toys.
意味は、「散らばったおもちゃの中で、自分のしっぽを追う猫」。its own tail(自分のしっぽ)＋ scattered toys(散らかったおもちゃ)。動作と周囲。
Of the three clocks on the wall, the one in the middle shows a different time from the other two.
the one in the middle shows a different time from the other two.
意味は、「3つのうち、真ん中の時計だけ時刻が違う」。the middle ... different time。どれが(真ん中)＋違い(時刻)を聞く。
A boy is holding a fishing rod, but instead of a fish, an old boot is hanging from the line.
instead of a fish, an old boot is hanging from the line.
意味は、「釣り糸の先に、魚ではなく古い長靴」。instead of a fish(魚ではなく)＋ old boot。予想外の釣果がポイント。
Let's leave at nine.
The museum opens at ten anyway, and it's about an hour away. Leaving at nine means waiting outside.
Good point — let's leave at nine thirty.
let's leave at nine thirty.
意味は、「10時開館・片道1時間なので、9時発では早すぎ→9時30分発に」。9時では待つ→計算して9:30発に修正。開館時刻と所要時間から逆算。
I'll take a dozen roses, please.
We only have eight red ones left, but plenty of white.
Then make it eight red and four white.
eight red and four white.
意味は、「赤は8本しかないので、赤8本＋白4本で計12本(1ダース)に」。a dozen=12本。赤8本の不足を白4本で補い計12本。数を計算する。
Let's meet on the second floor.
The second floor is closed for cleaning. The café on the third is open.
Third-floor café, then.
The café on the third is open. — Third-floor café, then.
意味は、「2階が清掃で閉鎖→3階のカフェに変更」。closed for cleaning → third-floor café。当初の2階が使えず変更。
Shall we watch the fireworks from the park?
The park will be packed. The mall rooftop has a great view and far fewer people.
Let's go to the rooftop, then.
The mall rooftop has a great view ... Let's go to the rooftop.
意味は、「公園は混むので、モールの屋上から見る」。park will be packed → mall rooftop。混雑を避けて場所を変更。
Have you started the science project yet?
It's on my very long to-do list.
It's on my very long to-do list.
意味は、「長い『やることリスト』に載っている(=まだ手をつけていない)」。on my to-do list =「これからやる予定」。まだ着手していないことを暗示。
How was the long train journey?
I finished two whole books.
I finished two whole books.
意味は、「本を2冊も読み終えた(=とても長い時間だった)」。本を2冊読めた=それだけ時間があった、で長さを表す。
Do you want to try my grandmother's homemade pickles?
I'll pass, thanks — my stomach's a bit sensitive today.
I'll pass, thanks — my stomach's a bit sensitive today.
意味は、「遠慮しておくよ、今日は胃の調子がいまひとつで」。I'll pass =「遠慮する」。理由を添えた丁寧な辞退。
Are you nervous about tomorrow's driving test?
I've failed it twice already.
I've failed it twice already.
意味は、「もう2回も落ちている(=だから不安)」。過去2回の不合格を挙げ、緊張・不安を暗に示す。
Why is the road so quiet this morning?
Schools are on holiday, so there's no rush hour.
Schools are on holiday, so there's no rush hour.
意味は、「学校が休みで、ラッシュアワーがないから」。schools on holiday → no rush hour。休みで交通量が少ない。
Should we sit at the front for the concert?
The speakers right there are really loud, though.
The speakers right there are really loud, though.
意味は、「前の席はスピーカーがすぐそばでとても大きい(=避けたい)」。speakers really loud を挙げ、最前列を避けたほうがよいと暗に示す。

Welcome to the Community Sports Center. The swimming pool is on the first floor. The gym, which used to be on the second floor, has moved up to the third floor to make room for a new dance studio, which is now on the second floor. The climbing wall is down in the basement. Reception is by the main entrance on the first floor.
The swimming pool is on the first floor.
意味は、「プールは1階」。冒頭。first floor。
a new dance studio, which is now on the second floor.
意味は、「新設のダンススタジオは2階」。ジムが抜けた2階に新設。『ジムの跡地=2階』を取り違えない。
The gym, which used to be on the second floor, has moved up to the third floor.
意味は、「ジムは2階から3階へ移動」。used to be on 2nd → moved up to 3rd。移動ワナ。
The climbing wall is down in the basement.
意味は、「クライミングウォールは地下1階」。down in the basement =「地下」。

Here is today's seminar schedule. The keynote talk is at ten. The workshop was set for eleven, but it's been swapped with the panel discussion, so the panel is at eleven and the workshop moves to one. Networking closes the day at three.
The keynote talk is at ten.
意味は、「10時は基調講演」。keynote talk at ten。
the panel is at eleven.
意味は、「入れ替えで11時はパネル」。swapped → panel at eleven。取り違え注意。
the workshop moves to one.
意味は、「ワークショップは13時に移動」。moves to one =「1時に移動」。
Networking closes the day at three.
意味は、「15時は交流会で締め」。networking at three。
Number one. Bike A has a basket and comes with a light, but it costs thirty-five thousand yen.
Number two. Bike B comes with a light and costs twenty-eight thousand yen, but it has no basket.
Number three. Bike C has a basket and costs twenty-five thousand yen, but a light is not included.
Number four. Bike D has a basket, comes with a light, and costs twenty-nine thousand yen.
Bike D: a basket, a light included, twenty-nine thousand yen.
意味は、「自転車D=かご付き・ライト付属・2万9千円で全条件を満たす」。1=3万5千円(✕)、2=かごなし(✕)、3=ライトなし(✕)、4=全条件を満たす。

Walking may be the most underrated form of exercise. It needs no equipment, no gym membership, and almost anyone can do it. Yet the benefits are remarkable. Regular walking strengthens the heart and helps control weight, and studies link it to a lower risk of several diseases. Walking is good for the mind, too: a brisk walk can reduce stress and even boost creativity, which is why some people have their best ideas on a stroll. Walking outdoors in nature seems to help even more. And unlike intense workouts, walking is gentle on the joints, so people can keep doing it throughout their lives. Experts note that the benefits build up gradually — you don't need to walk for hours at a time. Even short walks, spread through the day, make a real difference. The hardest part, they say, is simply turning it into a daily habit.
the benefits build up gradually ... The hardest part is turning it into a daily habit.
意味は、「ウォーキングは手軽で体と心に多くの効果があり、習慣化が鍵」。手軽さ→多くの効果→『効果は徐々に、習慣化が最難関』が結論。
It needs no equipment, no gym membership, and almost anyone can do it.
意味は、「道具もジムの会員も要らず、ほぼ誰でもできる」。no equipment, no membership。手軽さ(underrated=過小評価)の中身。
strengthens the heart; reduces stress and boosts creativity; gentle on the joints.
意味は、「効果は心臓・体重・ストレス・創造性・関節。身長は述べていない」。『身長が伸びる』は本文に無い。挙がっていない選択肢を選ぶ。
a brisk walk can reduce stress and even boost creativity.
意味は、「ストレスを減らし、創造性を高めうる」。reduce stress + boost creativity。散歩中に良い考えが浮かぶ理由。
unlike intense workouts, walking is gentle on the joints, so people can keep doing it.
意味は、「関節に優しく、一生続けられる」。gentle on the joints =「関節に優しい」。継続しやすさが利点。
the benefits build up gradually ... Even short walks, spread through the day, make a real difference.
意味は、「効果は徐々に積み重なり、短い歩行を分けるだけでも差が出る」。build up gradually + short walks spread through the day。少しずつでよい。
The hardest part is simply turning it into a daily habit.
意味は、「毎日の習慣にすること」。the hardest part =「最も難しい部分」。継続=習慣化が課題。
I study much better in a group — we explain things to each other and it keeps me motivated.
Groups help for tricky topics, but I often just end up chatting and losing focus. I memorize best alone, in silence.
You could set a timer and save the chatting for breaks.
Maybe study alone first, then meet up to check answers and explain the hard parts.
I often just end up chatting and losing focus. I memorize best alone, in silence.
意味は、「おしゃべりで集中が切れやすく、一人静かだと最も暗記できるから」。chatting and losing focus + memorize best alone。集中と暗記が理由。
study alone first, then meet up to check answers and explain the hard parts.
意味は、「まず一人で勉強し、後で集まって答え合わせと難所の説明をする」。個人学習と集団学習を順番で組み合わせる折衷案。
Four students are discussing whether students should be free to choose all of their own subjects.
I'm for it — we'd study what we're passionate about and stay motivated.
But at fifteen, we don't always know what we'll need later. Some basics should stay required.
And if everyone avoids hard subjects like math, we might really regret it at exam time.
What if a core set of subjects stays required, but we get more free choices added on top?
at fifteen, we don't always know what we'll need later. Some basics should stay required.
意味は、「15歳では将来必要なものが分からず、基礎は必修で残すべきだから」。don't know what we'll need later → basics should stay required。基礎必修の必要性。
a core set of subjects stays required, but we get more free choices added on top.
意味は、「中核の必修は残し、その上に自由選択を増やす」。必修(基礎)＋自由選択の追加、という妥協案。動機づけと基礎の両立。
I'd printed all the handouts the night before, but I left the whole stack on the printer at home, so I had to share with a classmate.
I left the whole stack on the printer at home.
意味は、「印刷はしたが、束ごと家のプリンターに置いてきた」。printed でも left ... at home(置き忘れ)。『印刷した』に安心しない。
I ordered a small coffee, but they handed me a large by mistake — I certainly wasn't going to complain.
they handed me a large by mistake — I wasn't going to complain.
意味は、「小を頼んだのに大が来たが、文句を言う気はなかった」。large by mistake + wasn't going to complain(文句は言わない=むしろ得)。
I thought the shortcut would save time, but I got completely lost and arrived even later than usual.
I got completely lost and arrived even later than usual.
意味は、「近道のつもりが迷って、いつもより遅く着いた」。would save time, but got lost → later。狙いと結果が逆。
I was planning to study at the library, but it was completely full, so I ended up at a quiet café.
it was completely full, so I ended up at a quiet café.
意味は、「図書館が満席で、静かなカフェで勉強した」。planning ... library but full → café。当初の予定が変更に。
A man is walking three dogs, and their leashes have become completely tangled around his legs.
walking three dogs, their leashes tangled around his legs.
意味は、「3匹の犬を散歩させ、リードが足に絡まっている」。数(3匹)＋状態(リードが絡まる)。犬の数と困った様子。
There are five apples in the bowl, and one of them has a single bite taken out of it.
five apples, one of them has a single bite taken out.
意味は、「5個のうち、1個だけ一口かじられている」。数(5個)＋どれが(1個)＋状態(一口かじられた)。
A child is drawing on the wall with crayons while the babysitter is fast asleep on the sofa.
drawing on the wall with crayons while the babysitter is asleep.
意味は、「シッターが寝ている間に、子どもが壁にクレヨンで描いている」。on the wall(壁に)＋ while the babysitter is asleep(眠っている間に)。状況全体。
Let's order two cheese pizzas.
Three of our friends said they can't eat cheese. How about one cheese and one tomato-only?
Okay — one cheese and one tomato pizza.
one cheese and one tomato pizza.
意味は、「チーズが食べられない友人がいるので、チーズ1枚＋トマトのみ1枚に」。当初チーズ2枚→1枚をトマトのみに変更。理由(cheese不可)も聞き取る。
I'll take the medium jacket in black.
The black medium is sold out. We have black small or navy medium.
Navy medium, please.
Navy medium, please.
意味は、「黒のMが売り切れなので、紺のMに」。希望(黒M)が完売→サイズは維持し色を紺に。色とサイズを両方追う。
Let's meet Saturday morning.
I have a dentist appointment Saturday morning. The afternoon works better for me.
Saturday afternoon, then.
The afternoon works better ... Saturday afternoon, then.
意味は、「午前は歯医者なので、土曜の午後に変更」。morning → afternoon。歯科の予約を理由に時間帯を変更。
Shall we go to the beach on Sunday?
They're forecasting thunderstorms. The science museum has a new exhibit, though.
The museum sounds safer — let's do that.
The science museum has a new exhibit ... let's do that.
意味は、「雷雨の予報なので、海をやめて科学博物館へ」。thunderstorms → museum。悪天候を理由に屋内の代案へ。
Are you going to eat that last slice of cake?
I've already had three.
I've already had three.
意味は、「もう3切れ食べた(=これ以上はいらない)」。すでに3切れ、と述べて『自分はもういらない=どうぞ』を暗に伝える。
How was the four-hour meeting?
I've had dental appointments that felt quicker.
I've had dental appointments that felt quicker.
意味は、「歯医者のほうが早く感じたくらいだ(=とても長かった)」。『歯科治療より長く感じた』という比較で、退屈な長さを表す皮肉。
Do you like my new haircut?
It's... bold.
It's... bold.
意味は、「うーん…大胆だね(=好みかどうか微妙)」。bold を口ごもって言うのは、はっきりほめられない遠回し表現。
Can you come to my piano recital on Sunday?
I wouldn't miss it for the world.
I wouldn't miss it for the world.
意味は、「何があっても絶対に見逃さない(=必ず行く)」。wouldn't miss it for the world =「何があっても行く」。強い肯定の慣用句。
Why are you carrying an umbrella? It's sunny.
The forecast said heavy rain by the afternoon.
The forecast said heavy rain by the afternoon.
意味は、「午後には大雨の予報だから」。今は晴れでも forecast said heavy rain by the afternoon。後の雨に備えている。
Should we take the shortcut through the woods?
It gets really dark in there after sunset, though.
It gets really dark in there after sunset, though.
意味は、「日没後、森の中はとても暗くなる(=近道は避けたい)」。really dark after sunset を挙げ、森の近道を避けたほうがよいと暗に示す。

Welcome to Seaside Hotel. The restaurant is on the first floor. The spa, which used to be on the second floor, has moved up to the top floor for a better ocean view. The gym is down in the basement. The business center is on the first floor, next to reception.
The restaurant is on the first floor.
意味は、「レストランは1階」。冒頭。first floor。
The spa, which used to be on the second floor, has moved up to the top floor.
意味は、「スパは2階から最上階へ移動」。used to be on 2nd → top floor。移動ワナ。
The gym is down in the basement.
意味は、「ジムは地下1階」。down in the basement =「地下」。
The business center is on the first floor, next to reception.
意味は、「ビジネスセンターは1階の受付の隣」。first floor, next to reception。階＋位置。

Here is today's bus tour schedule. We visit the castle first, at nine. The garden stop was planned for ten, but we've swapped it with the market, so the market is at ten and the garden moves to one. We return to the hotel at three.
We visit the castle first, at nine.
意味は、「9時は城」。castle at nine。
the market is at ten.
意味は、「入れ替えで10時は市場」。swapped → market at ten。取り違え注意。
the garden moves to one.
意味は、「庭園は13時に移動」。moves to one =「1時に移動」。
We return to the hotel at three.
意味は、「15時はホテルに帰着」。return to the hotel at three。
Number one. Program A is on weekends and needs no special qualification, but it doesn't cover your transport costs.
Number two. Program B covers transport costs and needs no qualification, but it's on weekdays.
Number three. Program C is on weekends and covers transport, but you need a first-aid certificate.
Number four. Program D is on weekends, covers transport costs, and needs no special qualification.
Program D: weekends, covers transport costs, no special qualification.
意味は、「プログラムD=週末・交通費支給・資格不要で全条件を満たす」。1=交通費なし(✕)、2=平日(✕)、3=資格が必要(✕)、4=全条件を満たす。

For thousands of years, humans have kept animals as companions, and modern research is showing why this bond is so valuable. Studies find that stroking a dog or cat can lower blood pressure and reduce stress hormones. Pet owners, especially dog owners, tend to get more exercise, since dogs need daily walks. Pets can also ease loneliness; for people living alone or for the elderly, an animal offers company and a daily routine. In some schools and hospitals, visiting animals are used to comfort children and patients. However, experts remind us that a pet is a serious responsibility: they cost money, need time and care, and live for many years. Choosing a pet that fits one's lifestyle is essential, and no one should get an animal on impulse. Still, for those who are truly ready, the companionship of a pet can bring real and lasting benefits to both body and mind.
a pet is a serious responsibility ... for those truly ready, the companionship brings lasting benefits.
意味は、「ペットは心身に多くの利点をもたらすが、責任と準備が必要だ」。利点の列挙→『しかし責任が伴う』→『準備ができた人には利点』という構成。
stroking a dog or cat can lower blood pressure and reduce stress hormones.
意味は、「血圧を下げ、ストレスホルモンを減らす」。lower blood pressure + reduce stress hormones。触れ合いの生理的効果。
more exercise; ease loneliness; comfort children and patients.
意味は、「利点は運動増・孤独の緩和・癒やし。『必ず友達が増える』は述べていない」。『必ず友達が増える』は本文に無い。挙がっていない選択肢を選ぶ。
dog owners tend to get more exercise, since dogs need daily walks.
意味は、「犬には毎日の散歩が必要だから」。dogs need daily walks =「犬は毎日の散歩が必要」。だから飼い主も歩く。
an animal offers company and a daily routine.
意味は、「孤独を和らげ、仲間と日々の習慣を与える」。company and a daily routine =「仲間と日課」。孤独の緩和が役割。
a pet is a serious responsibility ... no one should get an animal on impulse.
意味は、「ペットは費用・時間・世話が必要で長生きするので、衝動で飼ってはいけない」。serious responsibility + not on impulse。安易に飼わない注意。
for those who are truly ready, the companionship brings real and lasting benefits to both body and mind.
意味は、「準備ができた人には、ペットとの触れ合いが心身に長く続く利点をもたらす」。truly ready + lasting benefits to body and mind。責任を前提にした前向きな結論。
I've started exercising before school — it wakes me up and I feel sharper all day.
That sounds great, but I already struggle to get enough sleep. Getting up even earlier would just make me more tired.
You could go to bed earlier to make up for it.
Maybe light morning exercise on days I've slept well, and extra rest when I really need it.
I already struggle to get enough sleep. Getting up even earlier would just make me more tired.
意味は、「もともと睡眠不足で、早起きするとかえって疲れるから」。struggle to get enough sleep → more tired。睡眠不足が慎重な理由。
light morning exercise on days I've slept well, and extra rest when I really need it.
意味は、「よく眠れた日は軽い運動、必要なときは休息を優先する」。体調に応じて運動と休息を使い分ける柔軟な折衷案。
Four students are discussing whether their school trip should be domestic or overseas.
Overseas would be an amazing experience — a new culture and a chance to use our English.
But going abroad is far more expensive, and not every family could afford it.
There's also the worry of getting sick or lost somewhere we don't speak the language.
What if we go somewhere domestic but choose a place with an international community, so we still meet different cultures at a lower cost?
going abroad is far more expensive, and not every family could afford it.
意味は、「海外は費用がずっと高く、すべての家庭が負担できるとは限らないから」。far more expensive + not every family could afford。費用の公平性が反対理由。
go somewhere domestic but choose a place with an international community, at a lower cost.
意味は、「国内でも国際色のある場所を選び、低コストで異文化に触れる」。海外の利点(異文化)と国内の利点(低コスト・安全)を両立させる妥協案。
